d:
Pyar, dosti aur bharose ke rishte ke pichhe agar jasusi ka maqsad chhipa ho, to ise hani traip kaha jata hai. jensan huaang aur kathit chini jasus ailis huaang se jure vivad ne ek bar phir is shabd ko charcha men la diya hai.
Halanki, philhal is mamle men hani traip ya gopniy jankari sajha kie jane ke koee sabut samne nahin aae hain.
Hani traip kya hota hai, itihas men iske charchit mamle kaun se rahe hain aur AI aur saibar suraksha ke daur men bhi yah rashtriy suraksha ke lie itna bara khatra kyon hai.
Prazentar aur prodyusar: svati bakshi
